owned_invariants: Four domains are registered, each under one name with one checker: group_commutator, linear_refusal, stabilizer_commutation and u1_anomaly. checker returns nothing for any other name.

A checker works out the true answer from the item's data alone, says whether the reply gives it, and returns the true answer as the witness. Data or a reply it cannot read is an error with the reason, never a pass.

stabilizer_commutation: the generators are a nonempty list of strings over I, X, Y, Z of one length. Two strings anticommute when the number of sites at which their letters anticommute is odd. The reply must list exactly the anticommuting pairs; a pair may be written in either order and the pairs in any order.
u1_anomaly: the charges are a nonempty list of exact rationals. The reply must give the sum of the charges, the sum of their cubes, and anomaly_free true exactly when both sums are zero.
group_commutator: for permutations g and h of n points, n from 1 to 8, the reply must give the inverse of g, then the inverse of h, then g, then h, composed in reading order.
linear_refusal: the reply is graded by WF7's rank test and passes when that verdict is certified or a typed refusal. The witness is WF7's witness with the verdict's code.
boundaries: A checker covers one item. It says nothing about how the reply was produced.
The witness of a failed item is the true answer. A caller that must not reveal it keeps the witness out of prompts; the families here only hash it or report it in the verdict.
linear_refusal inherits the limits of wf07.rs: the system's size is not bounded here.

score.level_basis: Typed refusals on every failure path, closed requests, exact unbounded integers and rationals, no float, no unwrap or expect.

basis.G2: Exact: charge sums are exact rationals, pair indices are unbounded integers, and permutations are usize lists of at most 8 points. The point limit is asserted by value, one inside and one outside. Not B: tested against hand-worked items, not proven.
basis.G3: Every unreadable shape has its own reason. Permutations are read by perm::read before any product, and generators are length-checked before they are zipped. No unwrap, expect or index. Not B: panic-freedom is tested, not proven.
